8 اختوى He abstained from food: and it may mean he became void of everything but anger. (Ham p. 219.) ―
-b2- He lost his reason, or intellect. (K.) ＝
-A2- See also 1, last sentence. ―
-b2- Also He took away a thing. (JK.) He took altogether, or entirely, what another possessed; as also ↓ اخوى . (JK, K.) ―
-b3- He (a beast of prey) stole and ate the young one of a cow. (IAar, K.) ―
-b4- He cut off for himself (اِقْتَطَعَ) a land, or district; (IAar, K;) as also اختات and تخوّت. (IAar, TA.) ―
-b5- He thrust at a horse in his خَوَآء; i. e., the space between his fore legs and his hind legs. (JK, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
